candidates.source_description: If countries had sound pt.3. Each country's population is both the line and the pitch of the sound: the higher the population, the higher the note. Countries in order: Germany (1900-2025, through both world wars), Bulgaria, Iran, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Jordan, Qatar. Method: the pitch follows the population curve, the country is drawn on a globe in its colour with its flag, and every number is real data with no projections.
